events.text: there's a charge from you guys on my card that I didn't make. $28.10 from yesterday, Oct 23. I haven't ordered from Forkful since my pho order in mid-October, so I'm really confused about what this is.

I'm sorry about that unexpected charge. I can look into it, but first I need to verify your identity. Please give me the following:

1. Your full name as it appears on the account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
Sure. My full name is Grace Kim. The email on the account is gracekim@mailbox.example, and my phone is (415) 555-0105.

args.summary: Verified customer Grace Kim reports a $28.10 charge on Oct 23 for order O-5109 (Burger Barn, delivered to 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA; Visa 4242) that she says she did not place. Her default address is 15 Orchard St, Oakdale. Her last known order was Pho Real O-5071 on Oct 15. Needs review of the charge.

events.text:
I've escalated your case to a specialist. The reference is ESC-700, and they will contact you within 24 hours.

The delivery address on that order doesn't match the address on your account. The specialist will have that detail. In the meantime, you may want to check your card statement and consider contacting your card issuer if you see other charges you don't recognize.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Wait, what delivery address? I've never had anything delivered to Riverton. I don't even know anyone there. Can't you just refund the $28.10 right now? I'd rather not wait a whole day to get my money back. And is my account safe, or do I need to change my password?

I understand you'd rather not wait. But I can't refund this myself. Policy requires a specialist to review any charge a customer says they didn't place, and a refund from me now would bypass that review. The delivery address was 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950. I've added to your case that you don't recognize it or anyone there.

On your account: I can't see any security or login activity, so I can't tell you whether it was accessed. An order going to an address you don't know, charged to your card on file, could mean someone else used your account or your card details. I'd take these steps now:

1. Change your Forkful password, and use one you don't use anywhere else.
2. Check your card statement for other charges you don't recognize. If you see any, call your card issuer. They can lock or replace the card.
3. Keep an eye on your account for orders you didn't place.

The specialist handling ESC-700 will follow up within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, I'll change my password now. So the specialist will handle the refund, and I just wait for them? I'd still like to know if my account is safe before I go to bed.

Yes, the specialist will review the charge and follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, including whether you'll get a refund. You don't need to do anything else on that for now. If you want, you can reply to their follow-up with anything useful, such as other charges you spot on your statement.

I can't tell you your account is safe. I have no access to login or security records, so I can't confirm whether anyone else got in. I can tell you what I do see:

- Your account shows only two recent orders: the Pho Real order on Oct 15, which you made, and the Oct 23 Burger Barn order.
- Nothing else has been refunded, credited, or changed on the account.

Changing your password tonight is the right step. If you want more certainty, call your card issuer about the card ending in 4242. They can tell you whether other charges have gone through and can replace the card if needed. I've also noted the unfamiliar address on the case so the specialist can look into how the order was placed.

Is there anything else I can help with tonight?

Okay. So the specialist will get back to me within 24 hours, and I'll call my card issuer tonight about the 4242 card. Can you tell me if the Oct 23 order was placed from the app or the website? I don't remember ever using either for Burger Barn, so I want to know if it's on my phone or computer.

args.summary: Follow-up to ESC-700 for order O-5109. Customer Grace Kim asks whether the order was placed via the app or the website, and from which device, because she doesn't recall using either for Burger Barn. Support chat has no access to this info. She also doesn't recognize the Riverton delivery address, has been advised to change her password, and is contacting her card issuer about the Visa ending 4242.

I've added your question to the case. It's logged as ESC-701, a follow-up to ESC-700. The specialist will contact you within 24 hours.

Tonight, change your password and call your card issuer about the card ending in 4242. Is there anything else I can help with?
